import os,glob,re
def load():

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # connected components of 2s (8-conn)
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]; comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==2 and not seen[i][j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and g[ny][nx]==2 and not seen[ny][nx]:
                                seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                comps.append(cells)
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    n=len(comps)
    for a in range(n):
        for b in range(a+1,n):
            A,B=comps[a],comps[b]
            ra=(min(c[0] for c in A),max(c[0] for c in A)); rb=(min(c[0] for c in B),max(c[0] for c in B))
            ca=(min(c[1] for c in A),max(c[1] for c in A)); cb=(min(c[1] for c in B),max(c[1] for c in B))
            lo=max(ra[0],rb[0]); hi=min(ra[1],rb[1])
            if lo<=hi:  # row overlap
                r=(lo+hi)//2
                colsA=[c[1] for c in A if c[0]==r]; colsB=[c[1] for c in B if c[0]==r]
                if colsA and colsB:
                    l,rgt=max(colsA),min(colsB)
                    if l>rgt: l,rgt=rgt,l
                    for x in range(l+1,rgt): out[r][x]=1
            lo=max(ca[0],cb[0]); hi=min(ca[1],cb[1])
            if lo<=hi:  # col overlap
                c=(lo+hi)//2
                rowsA=[x[0] for x in A if x[1]==c]; rowsB=[x[0] for x in B if x[1]==c]
                if rowsA and rowsB:
                    t,b=max(rowsA),min(rowsB)
                    if t>b: t,b=b,t
                    for y in range(t+1,b): out[y][c]=1
    return out
